reviews.title: Doesn’t fit the smaller screen of iPhone SE 2022
reviews.text:
Very nice looking app from what I could see, however I’m sad to say that I had to delete this app before I could check everything out. On certain screens some things were behind others or partially off the screen, and made navigation impossible.

This is the 3rd app I’ve had this issue with in the past few months so I guess people are forgetting these little phones are still out there. Small and lightweight, it’s easy to stuff in a pocket for on the go, and no need to pull out the full size phone & risk dropping it. 

Best of luck to the dev, if you decide to try and fix these things I would love to download the update!  :)

reviews.title: Nothing but a cutesy interface, no real benefit.
reviews.text: At first look, this seems like a good way to track your goals but on closer examination all the app does is pull data from Apple Health.  The interface is cute, but all your step data is available on the Apple app.  The only additional benefit is logging your water intake. After initial setup there is no way to modify the alarms that are set for water reminders.  Also, they make a big deal out of asking for your daily step goal and then putting together a plan to attain the goal.  But the goal seems to be set to get you to the popular 10,000 daily steps and not to the personal goal they asked you to establish.  With no way to get back to the setup options the app is useless. I spent $19.99 for a year subscription, and ended up canceling and deleting the app.
